mapper.sql: B.BIZ_ID, B.BIZ_NAME, B.OWNER_NAME, B.ADDRESS, B.BIZ_TYPE, B.REPORTED_ON, B.RECEIPT_NO, B.STATUS, B.CLOSED_ON, B.CREATED_BY, B.CREATED_AT, (SELECT MAX(C.CHECKED_ON) FROM HYGIENE_CHECK C WHERE C.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID) AS LAST_CHECKED_ON, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HYGIENE_CHECK C WHERE C.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID) AS CHECK_COUNT, (SELECT C.RESULT FROM HYGIENE_CHECK C WHERE C.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID AND C.CHECK_ID = (SELECT MAX(C2.CHECK_ID) FROM HYGIENE_CHECK C2 WHERE C2.BIZ_ID = B.BIZ_ID)) AS LAST_RESULT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FOOD_BUSINESS (BIZ_ID, BIZ_NAME, OWNER_NAME, ADDRESS, BIZ_TYPE, REPORTED_ON, RECEIPT_NO, STATUS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{bizName}, #{ownerName}, #{address}, #{bizType}, #{reportedOn, jdbcType=DATE}, #{receiptNo}, 'OPEN', #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM FOOD_BUSINESS B WHERE B.BIZ_ID = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE FOOD_BUSINESS SET STATUS = 'CLOSED', CLOSED_ON = #{on, jdbcType=DATE} WHERE BIZ_ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HYGIENE_CHECK (CHECK_ID, BIZ_ID, CHECKED_ON, RESULT, VIOLATION, ACTION, INSPECTOR_ID, INSPECTOR, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{checkId}, #{bizId}, #{checkedOn, jdbcType=DATE}, #{result}, #{violation}, #{action}, #{inspectorId}, #{inspector}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT CHECK_ID, BIZ_ID, CHECKED_ON, RESULT, VIOLATION, ACTION, INSPECTOR_ID, INSPECTOR, CREATED_AT FROM HYGIENE_CHECK WHERE BIZ_ID = #{bizId} ORDER BY CHECKED_ON DESC, CHECK_ID DESC
